content: PEP 621 / pyproject.toml spec (packaging.python.org/specifications/pyproject-toml + peps.python.org/pep-0621): [project] table; name is the ONLY statically-required key (string, tools MUST require static definition, cannot be dynamic); version required but may be static string OR listed in dynamic = ["version"]; description optional string = one-line summary (Summary metadata); readme (full description) is string or table; license may be inline table {file=...} or {text=...}; authors = array of inline tables; lack of [project] implies all fields dynamic; tools MAY use [tool] table (PEP 518) for their own settings e.g. [tool.poetry].
